title: Independent Rail
description: A session rail built INDEPENDENTLY on the marketplace authoring surface, from the published PARTS: SessionRail (the session catalog — already pure, it reads no context, store or driver), the rail chrome pieces (FraymRailBrand, FraymRailActions, FraymRailSessionBar, FraymRailFooter, StoreMigrationCard), and the three assembly hooks (useRailGroupAction, useRailSessionPresence, useRailActionSet) that carry judgement no third party could re-derive from the facts alone. Imports no shipped rail implementation. It speaks the rail slot's specVersion 2 CHANNEL contract — one facts observable, one action set, one capability surface — which replaced the 47 flat props that made the old seat unfillable by anyone but the host.
